items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: But Russell was in Milt Larkin's band for awhile, wasn't he?

ctx.x: This was in 1940 -- he went to California on vacation, and Mae went, his sister. Mae and Russell came back but Illinois stayed out there. That's when Lionel Hampton picked him up, and formed his band.
But Russell was in Milt Larkin's band for awhile, wasn't he?
For awhile. But Russell and Illinois
